title: Sync Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Sync module.

specs_reconciled.description: Number of spec artifacts involved in reconciliation.

divergence_severity.description: Worst divergence severity found across all spec pairs.

auto_merged.description: True if all conflicts were resolved automatically (MINOR only).

human_review_required.description: True if any MAJOR conflict requires human decision.

merge_strategy.description: Strategy used: auto (all MINOR), manual (human resolved MAJOR), escalated (too many conflicts to list).

conflicts_resolved.description: Count of conflicts resolved (auto or human).

conflicts_escalated.description: Count of conflicts that could not be resolved and were escalated.

sync_result_path.description: Path to the sync result artifact. e.g. .wabblespec/sync/result-<timestamp>.md
